name: Overmaster Pyron
label: Quest
description: Overmaster Pyron: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The last five of my mages that went snooping around in Blackrock Mountain came back extra crispy with a permanent orange gnomefro - or worse.
Jalinda picks up some ashes from the ground and releases them into the air.
One nasty bugger in particular, Overmaster Pyron, seems to be causing quite a bit of trouble. We need that elemental terminated so that our expedition crew can make its way into Blackrock Depths!
He guards the entrance at the Blackrock Quarry.
